T: Ogres are like onions. So is this menu.
D: An ogre sets out to rescue a princess so he can get his swamp back.
P: Serve the waffles when Donkey promises to make them in the morning.
S: Brown onions cut thick, separated, soaked in buttermilk for 30 minutes, dredged in flour, dipped in beaten egg and pressed into panko, fried at 180C for 2 minutes until deep golden. Smoky barbecue mayo.
Butter, brown sugar and golden syrup melted, flour, ginger, cinnamon and bicarb mixed in, chilled an hour, rolled and cut into little men, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, iced with gumdrop buttons.

Spinach wilted and squeezed dry, mixed with chopped artichoke hearts, cream cheese, sour cream, parmesan and garlic, topped with mozzarella and baked at 200C for 20 minutes until bubbling. Corn chips.
M: Shrek's pot bubbling in the swamp
Beef chuck browned in batches, onion, garlic and celery softened, red wine and stock, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours, peas and spinach stirred in at the end so it turns green. Crusty bread.
Chicken marylands rubbed with garlic, rosemary, lemon zest and salt, roasted at 200C for 50 minutes on a bed of halved potatoes and lemon wedges until the skin crackles.
W: in the morning, he's making waffles
Buttermilk batter with melted butter and separated eggs, the whites whipped and folded in, cooked in a hot waffle iron until crisp, served with whipped cream, strawberries and maple syrup.
K: green and murky, like the swamp
Green apple, cucumber, lime juice and a handful of mint blitzed with ice and a little honey until slushy.

s.how: Cut 3 brown onions into thick rings and soak in 300ml buttermilk for 30 minutes. Dredge in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into panko. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until deep golden. Mix 100g mayo with 3 tbsp barbecue sauce to dip.

Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 1 jar chopped artichoke hearts, 250g cream cheese, 100g sour cream, 50g parmesan and 2 crushed garlic cloves. Top with 100g mozzarella and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until bubbling. Serve with corn chips.

m.note: Shrek's pot bubbling in the swamp
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions, 3 garlic cloves and 2 celery sticks. Add 250ml red wine and 500ml stock, cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Stir in 200g peas and 100g spinach at the end. Serve with crusty bread.

w.note: in the morning, he's making waffles
w.how: Whisk 250g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 400ml buttermilk, 2 yolks and 80g melted butter. Whip 2 whites to soft peaks and fold through. Cook in a hot waffle iron until crisp. Serve with whipped cream, 250g strawberries and maple syrup.

d.note: green and murky, like the swamp
d.how: Core and chop 3 green apples and 1 cucumber. Blitz with the juice of 3 limes, a big handful of mint, 2 tbsp honey and 2 cups of ice until slushy. Pour into four glasses and serve straight away with a mint sprig.
